photos.desc: Cicuta virosa in the Oslo Botanical Garden, Oslo, Norway.
Cicuta virosa , Apiaceae, Cowbane, Northern Water Hemlock, habitus. The fresh subterranean parts of the blooming plant are used in homeopathy as remedy: Cicuta virosa (Cic.)
